verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable backend platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking setting or opt-out mechanism. Self-hosting with 'full control over data location' and image-metadata stripping are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
